subject: Who wants exercises in the 2nd edition of the BPA book ?

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: Who wants exercises in the 2nd edition of the BPA book ?
parts:
Dear all,

 

Michael Schaub and I have started working on a 2nd edition of the Bayesian Population Analysis, or BPA, book. We were wondering whether we want to have exercises again. For this we would like to ask this:

 

Among those who own either the first edition of the BPA book or the IPM book, what approximate percentage of the exercises have you tried to solve ?

 

Thanks and best regards  ---  M & M
